- Cline #13473 "fix: propagate Langfuse session telemetry": Fixes Langfuse session telemetry propagation across three scenarios: (1) Hub-backed sessions do not transport extensionContext (local-only), daemon's runtime built traces without clientName/clientVersion metadata even though hub client bakes X-CLIENT-TYPE/X-CLIENT-VERSION into provider headers — now reconstruct extensionContext.client from those headers during local runtime bootstrap so hub-backed Langfuse traces carry client identity and daemon's header re-resolution stops clobbering original X-CLIENT-TYPE; (2) Delegated agents (spawned sub-agents, configured agents, teammates) were built without distinctId/sessionId, their Langfuse traces had no userId/sessionId and did not group with parent — now thread host-resolved distinctId through RuntimeBuilderInput and root sessionId through delegated-agent config provider, copy both onto delegated AgentConfig; (3) Add @langfuse/vercel-ai-sdk v5.9.1, propagate userId/sessionId/conversationId/runId/iteration/provider/model context into AI SDK telemetry with explicit includeRuntimeContext, stable OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=cline-sdk. Alexi has NO observability/telemetry SDK integration yet (no Langfuse, no OpenTelemetry, no AI SDK telemetry hooks). Alexi src/core/orchestrator.ts L1-208 orchestrates provider calls but no telemetry export, src/core/sessionManager.ts L1-726 tracks session metadata + messages but no external tracing, src/providers/ handles model calls but no span instrumentation. Pattern valuable for production tracing/debugging (session grouping, user identity tracking, delegated agent context threading) but MODERATE priority only AFTER observability infrastructure decision is made (~12h to add Langfuse SDK + OTEL exporter + session/user ID propagation + delegated agent distinctId/sessionId inheritance + hub header reconstruction + AI SDK telemetry hooks IF Langfuse becomes chosen telemetry backend, requires observability strategy decision first). SKIP for now pending observability strategy (no immediate blocker, feature-complete without telemetry, observability is operational concern not user-facing capability).
- Cline #13465 "Treat an empty preserved capability list as unspecified when seeding tools": toSdkModelInfo guarded tools seeding with strict `preservedCapabilities === undefined` check, but modelHasCapability reader treats `undefined AND length === 0` as unspecified. Custom OpenAI-Compatible model whose stored capabilities field is defined-but-empty array (config carried over from before field existed, or round-tripped through boundary that defaults it to []) skipped seeding; first boolean projection (e.g. supportsReasoning) then populated array, runtime gate read non-empty tool-less list as authoritative, every tool definition silently dropped from session. Guard now covers empty array too, matching reader's unspecified semantics. Alexi src/providers/index.ts L50-200 handles model capabilities via getProviderForModel but no `preservedCapabilities` field exists in model config schema (routing-config.json + src/providers/ have model id strings, not stored-capabilities objects). Pattern N/A unless Alexi adds model persistence with capabilities field (~4h to add empty-array guard matching reader semantics IF model persistence with capabilities lands, LOW priority until model config grows capabilities persistence). Skip.

Alexi MCP servers configured via local mcp-servers.json (src/mcp/mcpManager.ts L1-300 reads user-owned config file, no marketplace, no remote policy enforcement). Pattern only relevant for multi-tenant/enterprise deployment with centralized MCP policy (~8h to add enterprise config layer + MCP allowlist enforcement + marketplace catalog filtering IF Alexi adds multi-tenant/enterprise deployment mode, LOW priority for CLI tool).
